purpose: Record what was actually inspected during the FUNUJE brand/interface source pull, and correct the Pass-1 record.

withdrawn_claims: No FUNUJE source material exists in the connected Google Drive.
All eight expected source assets are missing.
correction_notice.root_cause: The Funuje folder is owned by wrayveart@gmail.com and is shared-with-me, not owned by the authenticated account. It did not appear in corpora=allDrives enumeration and did not match name or fullText search. Pass 1 treated a discovery-method failure as a fact about the corpus.
correction_notice.standing_lesson: For shared-with-me Drive content, enumeration and search are unreliable. Direct access by file or folder ID is the only dependable path.

summary: FUNUJE source corpus located, opened and inspected. The authoritative brand document was read in full and 23 visual artifacts were inspected as images. Most of the operator-supplied brand system is now VERIFIED rather than asserted. Result is partial, not pass, because inspection surfaced two mutually incompatible design systems inside the same folder and a direct contradiction between the brand document and the product artifacts.

inspections.observed_result: Folder 'Funuje' resolved. Owner wrayveart@gmail.com, not trashed, can_list_children true, 134 children.
FUNUJE Brand Guidelines v001 exported as text/plain. 21 sections, 16104 bytes, extraction_status success, not truncated.

inspections.source: S1 section 5 vs work-order canonical inputs
inspections.observed_result: All eight hex values match the work order exactly with no drift. Section 5 additionally supplies a colour usage table assigning palettes to main layouts, label, producer section, artist profiles, premium, app UI and social.

Cyan Signal is defined for 'analytics, futuristic data, active streaming indicators, dashboard highlights'. The Pass-1 UNRESOLVED on this token is closed and the Pass-1 inference is confirmed, with scope widened beyond producer-only.
All nine zones and their purposes verified verbatim. Nav substitutions verified: Profile to Booth, Dashboard to Console, Library to Vault, Explore to Signal.
Mono list verified exactly. Body list is seven faces and OMITS Satoshi. No display face is named anywhere in S1; only personality attributes are given. Anton and Recoleta do not appear in S1 at all.

Panel 04 specifies SIGNAL RED #FF2A23, WARM CREAM #F4E9D1, DEEP OXBLOOD #4A0D0F, ELECTRIC PINK #FF5E8A, BURNT ORANGE #FF7A1A, CHARCOAL #111111, and names ANTON, Recoleta and Satoshi. These conflict with S1 on both palette and body typeface. Panel 05 defines tiers FREE/PREMIUM/STUDIO. Panel 06 shows four mobile screens with a Home/Search/Library/Profile tab bar.
inspections.method_caveat: Hex values transcribed from the panel's printed labels. Pixel sampling was not performed: the sandbox has no outbound network to Drive (curl returns HTTP 000) and Pillow is not installed.

inspections.observed_result: Lowercase and uppercase wordmarks, cream on red field, heavyweight geometric sans with the macron set as a detached bar rather than a diacritic. Two waveform-struck variants confirm Waveform as an identity-level motif. Letterform analysis indicates the wordmark is custom or heavily modified and is not a setting of Anton.

Sitemap uses Home, Discover, Release, Studio, Community, Library with detailed sub-branches including Studio: Upload Music, My Releases, Analytics, Audience, Rights Management, Payouts. The flow diagram renders Studio as the glowing highlighted hub node. Neither uses the nine zone names. The sitemap title drops the macron ('Funuje Platform Sitemap').

Red hero panel. Wordmark misspelt as 'funuju'. Headline 'Own Your Music. Reach Your Fans. No Middlemen.' with CTA 'Start Releasing Free'. Red reads coral/salmon, not #E31B23. Body face is a light humanist sans, not the brand display face.

Mr. Lexx / Diggy Nation responsive site. Nav HOME / VAULT / ARTISTS / DIGGY NATION. Red-rim-lit portrait, cream display name, glowing red CTA, FEATURED RELEASES cards with red play buttons. Closest artifact in the corpus to on-brand executed UI, and the only one retaining a zone name.

Places FUNUJE as the Music + Artist Development layer of WRASAL. WRASAL's own visual language is obsidian, warm ivory, muted gold, signal amber, deep emerald. S1 never mentions WRASAL. A code screenshot in the folder uses #1C1C21 and #C6A85C, which are WRASAL-family values, not FUNUJE palette.

Guidelines palette: cream on red 3.82:1 (AA normal FAIL, AA large PASS, AAA FAIL, non-text PASS); white on red 4.72:1 (AA normal PASS); red on obsidian 4.32:1; cream on obsidian 16.50:1; cyan on obsidian 11.62:1; gold on obsidian 8.53:1; smoke on obsidian 5.90:1; graphite on obsidian 1.14:1; wine on obsidian 1.45:1. Brand Kit palette: cream on red 3.11:1 and white on red 3.75:1, so no AA-normal-compliant label exists for a red primary button in that palette.
